state:
**Goal `coalesce-assign` — Stage 2 (`??=` as PHP's) is on disk; Stage 3 (the three defaulting operators) has nothing yet.**

`??=` now reads its target guarded and writes it plain (ADR 0254 § 7): `check_compound_assign`
marks each level with `presence::mark_guarded_target_reads` into the typed-expression table
(`ExprTypeTable::is_guarded_target_read`), never into `Env::coalesce_guarded`, and `nvs-ir` consults
the mark only while `Lowering::reading_guarded_target` is set around the read in
`lower_read_modify_write`. A nullable row under a `??=` target stays `E0482`. The expression's type
is the target's without `null` when the right side has none (§ 8). Gap
`nvs-ir/throws-on-an-array-key-that` is deleted, and `rule:php-migration/absent-storage-is-never-a-zero-value`'s
second paragraph says the `??=` read is the same guarded read.

`rule:expressions/defaulting-assignment` is still `designed`; it flips to `shipped` with the two
Stage 3 cases, as ADR 0254 says. `$a ??+= 1` is still `E0102`.

An absent optional shape field under `??=` takes the right side on the read and then throws on the
write, exactly as the plain `$u->nick = "b"` does; nothing pins it, and the goal's one-sentence rule
says that is the right answer.

items.text: **Three tokens and three `AssignOp`s** (ADR 0254, `rule:expressions/defaulting-assignment`) — `crates/nvs-syntax/src/lexer.rs:1009` lexes `??=` as one token beside `??`; add `??+=`, `??-=`, `??.=` there and at the token list `crates/nvs-syntax/src/lexer.rs:2646`, the kinds at `crates/nvs-syntax/src/token.rs:231`, the ops at `crates/nvs-syntax/src/ast.rs:371` (`AssignOp::binary_op` at `crates/nvs-syntax/src/ast.rs:385` keeps answering the operator, so a defaulting op needs its own question), and the parse at `crates/nvs-syntax/src/parser/expr.rs:256`. `$a ??-1` must still lex as `$a ?? -1`, and `??+` / `??-` are not operators. Test `the_defaulting_assignment_operators_lex_as_one_token_each`.

**Typing** — `crates/nvs-types/src/expr/assign.rs:1300` (`check_compound_assign`): `$a ??op= $v` is `$a = ($a ?? d) op $v`, `d` the zero of the target's type (`int`/`""` for `mixed` or a union), the read guarded like `??=`'s (`presence::mark_guarded_target_reads`), every refusal of `op` kept. Test `a_defaulting_add_assign_is_typed_as_the_sum_over_a_zero_of_the_target_type`, in `crates/nvs-types/tests/defaulting_assignment.rs`.

**Lowering** — `crates/nvs-ir/src/lower/stmt.rs:641` (`lower_read_modify_write`): one staged target, the guarded read (`reading_guarded_target` already exists), a `??` against a constant of the target's representation (`emit_const_one` at `crates/nvs-ir/src/lower/stmt.rs:719` is the model for a zero), then `op`. Test `a_defaulting_assignment_stages_its_target_once` in `crates/nvs-ir/src/lower/tests.rs`.

**LSP, fmt and the conformance case** — `crates/nvs-lsp/src/completion.rs:1441` lists `??=` among the operators after which an expression is offered; `crates/nvs-fmt/src/space.rs:86` is where spacing runs, and how it spaces an operator is *not checked*. Then `tests/conformance/lang/defaulting-assignment-counts-subtracts-and-appends-from-nothing.nvst`, and the rule flips to `shipped` with its `guardedBy`.

backlog: A write that narrows (`?int $n = null; $n ??= 1;` leaving `$n` an `int`) is for the user — goal file § *Standing decisions*.
`$a ?? ($a = f())` typed as the target — same, for the user.
`$this->x ??= 5` on an unwritten non-null typed property throws where PHP writes; `rule:classes/an-unwritten-property-read-throws` owns it, not this goal.
